column1: # The check at the holder (the door token contract, «The keys door/keys»): verify(keys, authorization, now, unit, holder, path) → ok or forbidden.

# keys — the value of the row door/keys (JSON); unit, holder — the holder's own; authorization — the Authorization header whole (empty — no header); path — the request target (the URL path and, maybe, a query); now — wall-clock seconds.
# The token: authorization «Bearer <token>», otherwise the single parameter t of the query; the first segment of the URL path without the query is compared with routes.
# claims — for ok: the claims read (the UTF-8 text of the claims part), for a refusal empty.
